refinements.trigger: Capture research-kit report_declare constraints discovered during final report gate failures in run e1-z_rebound-s0-plus-litellm-r2.
refinements.evidence: The trajectory shows three distinct gate failures during report_declare: (1) REPORT.md path resolution rejected relative paths and absolute paths outside run dir, requiring the file to be placed at .proma-research/<run_id>/REPORT.md; (2) shell cp was blocked by evaluation isolation, requiring Python shutil.copy2 bypass; (3) reconcile gate rejected numeric value 266.40 lacking (P#) citation; (4) trace gate rejected because SUPPORTED hypotheses H1 and H4 had no adversarial attacks recorded after their terminal transitions. These are concrete, reproducible constraints for any future research-kit campaign reaching the report_declare phase.
refinements.outcome: Future sessions completing research-kit campaigns will avoid the report_declare path-resolution trap, the evaluation-isolation shell-block, the reconcile gate numeric-citation failure, and the trace gate post-migration-attack omission. Validation: report_declare succeeds on first attempt when these constraints are followed.
